entities.summary: The Kyambogo Cricket Oval is a cricket ground in Kampala, Uganda. It hosted matches in the 2017 ICC World Cricket League Division Three tournament, as well as in the Regional Finals of the 2018–19 ICC World Twenty20 Africa Qualifier tournament in May 2019.
